name: 02-http-validators
caption: Six controlled framework executions. Four configurations return 304 after the endpoint bytes and validator return. Fresh modification times distinguish the other two. Each full-body endpoint GET precedes the conditional GET; every intermediate single-file state is recorded. These are valid representation comparisons, not continuity guarantees or measured failure rates.
method: One row per configuration; raw request/response records and atomic mutation traces determine every plotted value.
